Hi Alice / Helio team —

Thanks for the productive Q2 check-in last week. As discussed, this thread is to kick off the renewal + uplift coordination for your account (deal HL-2026-1123). High level: HelioHealth is moving from the current 12-month term to an 18-month commitment and is requesting a capacity uplift of ~35% across inference units (peak windows). We want to align stakeholders, confirm timeline, and lock the QBR slot where we'll review runbook, SLOs, and procurement steps.

Proposed next steps (quick):
- Confirm primary contacts for procurement, SRE, and security (reply here)
- Pick 2 candidate QBR slots next week (I proposed a Doodle below)
- I’ll share a mutual action plan and draft QBR agenda (attached) — we’ll iterate with your team

Draft timeline:
- 11/11 — kickoff and stakeholder alignment (this email)
- 11/16 — QBR (finalize term language + capacity targets)
- 11/20 — Procurement redlines / DocuSign routing
- 11/30 — Target go-live for uplift staging and capacity reservation

Attachments: Helio_renewal_mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf, qbr_agenda_draft.docx
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AxyzHelioQBR (mutual action plan + runbook)

- Tue 11/16, 10:00–11:00
- Tue 11/16, 14:00–15:00
- Wed 11/17, 09:00–10:00

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your team will attend? Also please copy your procurement lead if they’re a different address.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

- Alice Bowen (me) — Product & Platform

2) We’ll need an initial security evidence packet for our compliance team (SOC2, data residency details). If you can put that together into the Drive folder that would be helpful.

Alice / team —

Thanks — locking in 11/16 10:00–11:00 PT for the QBR tentatively. I’ll be the technical lead from Redwood for the runbook and uplift plan. A few technical checklist items we’ll cover in the QBR and in prep conversations:

- Traffic profile: need sample peak hour requests/day and 95th pct latency target to size autoscaling headroom.
- KV cache considerations: if you expect many short-chat flows we’ll recommend prefix caching to reduce cost and latency (we’ll show savings in the deck).
- Quantization / model variant: confirm which model variant you want to pin for the uplift (we can propose a quantized variant to reduce GPU footprint).
- Network & peering: Ramon — we’ll need VPC peering details or VPN window to stage the uplift.
- Security packet: Naomi, can you drop SOC2 and data residency notes into the Drive folder today?

Draft QBR agenda (60 min):
- 0–10m: Introductions & objectives (Marissa / Alice)
- 10–30m: Renewal terms & pricing options (Marissa)
- 30–45m: Technical uplift runbook & sizing (David)
- 45–55m: Procurement next steps & DocuSign timeline (Karthik)
- 55–60m: Actions & owners (all)

Attachments referenced: I uploaded an initial uplift-sizing worksheet to the Drive (folder linked in Marissa’s email). Naomi — if you can confirm security docs I’ll reference them in the agenda.

Marissa — once Alice confirms attendance we’ll send a calendar invite with a brief pre-read.

Thanks,
